svg.aria-label: Vapi voice switchboard: a vintage telephone switchboard console for voice AI agents. A handset rests in its cradle, three provider dials (STT, LLM, TTS) run the voice pipeline, two patch cords connect the jack strip to the n8n webhook socket block, the lit orange lamp is a tool call in progress, a transcript tape spools from a slot in the base, and the meter dial reads 4 concurrent calls. Hosting is $0.05/min with providers at cost; 1,200+ people attended VapiCon 2026.
svg.text: $0.05/min hosting · providers at cost · 4 concurrent calls · 1,200+ at VapiCon 2026
